Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

11 AM to 8 PM IST or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education: BE/BTech**
Required:
  
  

* 4-7 years of experience in Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition, Spring Boot, and microservices development.
* Core JAVA & Backend engineering:
* Strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8+) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.

* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency

* Strong understanding of data persistence, including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization, complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging, including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* AWS Cloud
* Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating full stack Java applications on AWS, leveraging cloud-native services and managed platforms.
* Experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS Lambda; ability to choose appropriate compute models for Java microservices and UI-backed APIs.
* Experience exposing and managing RESTful APIs using API Gateway and Application Load Balancer (ALB); integration with Angular/React frontends.
* Hands-on experience with RDS (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and DynamoDB; data modeling, performance tuning, and transactional integrity.
* Experience implementing security using IAM, Cognito, VPCs, security groups, and secrets management via Secrets Manager / Parameter Store.
* Experience deploying Angular/React applications using S3 + CloudFront, including CDN caching, environment configuration, and performance optimization.
* Experience with CI/CD using CodePipeline, CodeBuild, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins for Java and UI applications.
* Experience with Docker and EKS (Kubernetes) for containerized Java microservices and frontend workloads.
* Experience with CloudWatch, centralized logging, metrics, alerts, and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to diagnose production issues, optimize performance, and ensure high availability with minimal handholding.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding
* Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Certification (AWS):
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
* AWS Certified Developer - Associate
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with Spring Security, Spring Cloud, transaction management, and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Experience with SOAP services, external application programming interface integrations, and distributed service design.
* Experience with NoSQL databases.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning concepts, including natural language processing, deep learning, or computer vision.
* Experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or natural language processing libraries.

title: Senior Software Engineer Rust OR C++ Equities
description:
**Department Overview**
The
**Equities Technology**
division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Software Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**Rust**
and
**C++**
to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* System Design & Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency & Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.
* Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments.
* Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms.
* Collaboration & Support
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software.
* Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility.
* Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Programming Languages**

* C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL).
* Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem.

**Systems Programming & Low-Latency**

* Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls).
* Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
* Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers.

**Concurrency**

* Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures.

**Equities Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles.

**Tools & Infrastructure**

* Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack).
* Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration.
* Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF\_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK).
* Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

These systems are relied upon daily by thousands of fixed income traders and salespeople at the world’s leading financial institutions. We focus on the trader workflows starting from advertising an intention to trade to executing transactions with clients and other dealers in the market. In these workflows, we’re often dealing in microsecond latencies and at high throughput.
* Our SSPTE Data Acquisition team plays a critical role in the success of our business. We are responsible for acquiring and normalizing market data and reference data into a common schema feeding the core of our trading systems with the material that connects workflows.
* This data provides the trading system with a complete, real-time view of tradeable securities, markets, trading history and market activity, enabling integration of trading strategies, pricing models, analytics, and custom workflows. Crucially, EMS applications rely on consuming such market and reference data seamlessly, so that they can efficiently execute advanced EMS workflows, which often require microsecond latency.

description:

Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. **Key Responsibilities**
Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
  
  
Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
  
  
Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.
  
  
Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.
  
  
Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  
  
Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
3 to 6 Years of relevant experience
  
  
Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.
  
  
Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:
  
  

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
* Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
* Exposure to Agile software development
* Exposure to building analytical solutions
* Exposure to IoT technology

**Core Responsibilities Unique To The Role**

* Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains. 2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers. 3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.
  
  
**Required Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies. 2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products. 3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability. 4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders. 5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred (Nice To Have) Skills, Education, Or Experience**

* Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products. 2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

.

This is not a pure bookkeeping role. We need someone who can convert accounting data into clear financial insights for management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain complete and accurate books of accounts
* Prepare and review
  **monthly P&L statements**
* Build
  **project-wise and showroom-wise P&L**
* Track revenue, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and profitability
* Analyse
  **budget vs actual performance**
* Identify margin leakage, cost overruns and unusual expenses
* Track project-level:
* Revenue booked
* Collections
* Material cost
* Manufacturing cost
* Installation cost
* Logistics
* Discounts
* Rework / snag costs
* Gross profit
* Contribution margin
* Prepare weekly and monthly
  **management MIS**
* Maintain cash-flow forecasts and upcoming payment requirements
* Track customer receivables and ageing
* Track vendor payables and payment schedules
* Monitor purchase advances and vendor reconciliations
* Perform bank reconciliations
* Manage GST, TDS and statutory accounting requirements
* Coordinate with CA and auditors
* Verify purchase invoices, POs and payment approvals
* Track factory, showroom and corporate overheads separately
* Maintain machinery, fixed-asset and capex accounting
* Support payroll, incentives and reimbursements
* Develop financial controls to prevent duplicate, incorrect or unauthorized payments

**P&L Ownership**

The person should be comfortable preparing and explaining:

**Revenue**

Less: Material / Procurement Cost

Less: Manufacturing Cost

Less: Installation & Logistics

=
**Gross Profit**

Less: Sales & Marketing

Less: Showroom Expenses

Less: Factory Overheads

Less: Salaries & Admin

=
**EBITDA**

They should be able to clearly explain
**why profitability moved month-on-month**

, not simply produce the report.

**Management Reporting**

Expected reporting should include:

* Monthly consolidated P&L
* Project-wise profitability
* Showroom-wise profitability
* Factory cost report
* Gross-margin trends
* Marketing spend vs revenue
* Payroll as % of revenue
* Fixed vs variable costs
* Receivable ageing
* Payable ageing
* Cash-flow forecast
* Budget vs actual
* Capex tracker
* Revenue booked vs revenue collected
* Upcoming financial liabilities

**What We Expect**

We want someone who proactively flags:

“Gross margin has dropped from 42% to 35% this month.”

“This project has exceeded its installation budget.”

“Material cost on this category is running above target.”

“₹X is receivable but overdue.”

“Factory overhead has increased faster than revenue.”

“This showroom is generating revenue but is not yet contribution-positive.”

“Based on upcoming vendor payments and collections, we will require ₹X cash over the next 30 days.”

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance / equivalent
* 3–6+ years of relevant experience
* Strong understanding of
  **P&L, MIS, cost accounting and financial analysis**
* Strong Excel skills
* Experience with Tally / ERP systems
* Strong understanding of GST and TDS
* Experience in
  **manufacturing, furniture, interiors, construction or project-based businesses preferred**
* Comfortable working directly with founders and senior management
* Strong attention to detail with a commercial mindset

﻿

**Most Important Trait**

We are not looking for someone who only asks:

**“Has this invoice been entered?”**

We want someone who also asks:

**“Why did we spend this money, which project does it belong to, what margin are we making, and what does this do to the P&L?”**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Manager, Product Management, Scheme and Regulatory Compliance
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard Gateway, formerly known as MPGS, operates at the centre of the global payments ecosystem and supports customers across more than 70 countries. As an agnostic gateway serving acquirers, merchants, and partners globally, Mastercard Gateway must continuously respond to payment scheme mandates, regional regulatory requirements, and internal Mastercard compliance obligations.
  
  
From a Gateway Scheme Compliance perspective, this role is critical to ensuring that scheme and regulatory changes are identified early, assessed accurately, prioritized effectively, and delivered within mandated timelines. The role supports the translation of scheme communications, announcements, bulletin into clear business impact assessments, product roadmap priorities, execution plans, and stakeholder communications that help reduce financial, operational, reputational risk.
  
  
This role also supports gateway customers to gain benefit via reduced scheme fees, higher approval rates, and enable new MC product and services.
  
  
Role
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Scheme Compliance, the role holder will support the Product Compliance function for the Mastercard Gateway product suite. The primary objective is to strengthen MPGS readiness for scheme mandates and regulatory obligations by driving disciplined intake, impact assessment, prioritization, governance, and execution tracking across the product lifecycle.
  
  
The role will scan and analyse card scheme rules, bulletins, announcements, and mandates, assess applicability to MPGS, and convert these inputs into actionable roadmap items, compliance requirements, customer-impact assessments, and delivery priorities.
  
  
The role will manage the collection, assessment, and prioritization of scheme compliance initiatives across Gateway, working closely with Global Product Management, Regional Product teams, Product Management-Technical, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Operations, and Customer-facing teams. The role will also support governance forums and PI Planning inputs to ensure compliance priorities are visible, understood, and reflected in delivery plans.
  
  
The Compliance Product team is responsible for maintaining a structured relationship with Payment Schemes, including Mastercard, Visa, Amex, and other relevant networks, for receiving, analysing, clarifying, and operationalizing scheme bulletins and mandates.
  
  
In addition, the role holder will support internal and external communication, training, and readiness activities for stakeholders and customers impacted by scheme or regulatory changes.
  
  
Analyse card scheme communications, mandates, bulletins, and regulatory updates to identify applicability, business impact, customer impact, delivery risk, and compliance deadlines for Mastercard Gateway.
  
  
Provide clear summaries of scheme rule changes and translate them into actionable requirements for impacted Gateway business areas.
  
  
Partner with Product, PMT, Region, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer-facing teams to ensure required changes are prioritized and delivered within mandated timelines.
  
  
Support roadmap planning and SAFe PI or Kanban Planning by ensuring scheme compliance priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines are clearly represented in delivery plans.
  
  
Maintain a central repository of scheme communications, impact assessments, decisions, evidence, and delivery status for auditability and transparency.
  
  
Build and maintain internal portals, trackers, and communication channels for scheme compliance updates and mandate visibility.
  
  
Define, document, and continuously improve internal processes for scheme compliance intake, triage, assessment, governance, escalation, and closure with end to end ownership.
  
  
Support MPGS business areas with scheme-related queries, clarifications, and interpretation of scheme requirements.
  
  
Prepare internal and external communications, training material, customer readiness updates, and implementation guidance for impacted stakeholders.
  
  
Liaise with payment networks and schemes where applicable to clarify requirements, represent MPGS considerations, and advocate appropriate Mastercard or customer positions.
  
  
Identify and escalate compliance gaps, delivery risks, financial exposure, and customer impacts in a timely manner, with recommended remediation and communication plans.
  
  
Use and bring AI efficiency in day-to-day work and in the compliance process which will add benefit to the Gateway and customers.
  
  
**All About You**
8+ years of experience in Product Management, Payments, Scheme Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Gateway products, Acquiring business, Merchant services, or related payments domains.
  
  
Strong understanding of card schemes authorization & clearing modules, payment gateways, acquirers, merchants, acquiring banks, ecommerce, card present, digital and token payment flows.
  
  
Experience interpreting scheme rules, mandates, bulletins, compliance requirements, and regulatory updates, with the ability to convert them into clear product requirement and delivery actions.
  
  
Experience working with agile and Kanban delivery models, ideally including SAFe, PI Planning, backlog prioritization, dependency management, and cross-team execution tracking.
  
  
Ability to build effective relationships across Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Regional, Commercial, Sales, Support, and Customer-facing teams.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess business impact, delivery complexity, financial exposure, reputational risk, and customer implications.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across global teams and time zones.
  
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex scheme requirements for both technical and business audiences.
  
  
Self-organized, self-driven with E2E ownership mindset, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global payments environment with evolving priorities and strict compliance deadlines.
  
  
Knowledge on AI tools, AI agents and application like Aha, Confluence, Jira is essential.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters

͏

**Do**

1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software

* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes

* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

͏

* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software

* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system

* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns

* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support implementation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.
